title: Dermoscopy AI risk score improves dermatologists' diagnoses in a reader study
summary: In a reader study with 104 dermatologists on 922 held-out lesions (345 malignant), a deep-learning risk score from dermoscopic images and metadata raised correct-diagnosis accuracy from 74.6% to 81.6%. Gains were largest for melanoma and high-grade dysplastic naevi. The design is retrospective, not prospective.
ai_technology: Deep-learning risk score from dermoscopic images and metadata
organization: Department of Dermatology, KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium

evidence.tested: Before-and-after reader assessments of an independent test set across multiple centers.
evidence.unknown: Effect in routine practice and on patient outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model produced a risk score shown to clinicians as decision support.
